verdict.rationale: Cline ships an official CLI. It installs via npm, supports interactive terminal chat and headless automation for CI/CD, accepts piped input, has auto-approve flags, and can run agents on cron schedules. A probe confirms dedicated CLI documentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI specifically (the community evidence discusses the editor extension).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use Cline CLI for interactive terminal sessions and automated headless workflows.
Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.
cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"
The CLI supports running agents on cron schedules through the hub.
